technique_question: What is the technique called when a raised design is formed by hammering sheet metal from its reverse side?
source_webpage_text:
Raising relief in sheet metal

Repoussé is used to create raised designs in sheet metal by hammering from the reverse side, often while the sheet rests on a yielding support. The metalworker turns the sheet over and works from the front to refine outlines and add definition; this complementary finishing process is known as chasing. Together, the operations can produce detailed relief without casting the design as a solid form.
